title: 高二多题听力：行程与周末集市
instruction: 听两段较长对话和一段独白，三组分别回答3、3、4题，共10题，每题三选。每段听两遍，听前每题5秒读题，听后每题5秒作答。音轨已含两遍与对应时间；本机可重播供审阅。来源原音频与脚本未取得，此处提供完整原创配套，不替来源补造。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We could save money by taking the early bus to the field centre. It gets there at seven.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: But the building does not open until half past eight. I would rather pay a little more for the later service than wait outside with all the equipment.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Fair point. The later one arrives at eight twenty. Should we buy tickets today?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. There are only eighteen seats, and the driver does not sell standing tickets.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will reserve two. Can we leave the equipment at the centre after the survey?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Only the waterproof boxes. We need to bring the cameras back because another group has booked them for Monday. I have written that on the return checklist.

questions.stem: Why does the woman prefer the later bus?
options: It avoids a long wait outside.
questions.rationale: 早车7点到而8:30开门，W不愿带设备外等；B未比较座位舒适，C明确无站票。

questions.stem: Why should the speakers book tickets now?
options: The number of seats is limited.
The driver has changed the route.
questions.rationale: 只有18座且不售站票；A无涨价，C无改线。

questions.stem: What must be brought back after the survey?
questions.rationale: 另一组周一预约相机，明确必须带回；A盒可留下，B无钥匙任务。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The stall next to ours will sell bread, so we should change our plan.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could we sell soup instead? It would go well with their bread.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That would be useful, but we have no safe way to keep soup hot outdoors. What about packs of seeds from the school garden? We already have envelopes and labels.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. We need to explain that some seeds are for pots and others need a large bed.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Exactly. Put that on the front, not just the plant name. People should know before they buy.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: What will we do with the money?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: First pay back the cost of the display boards. Anything left will buy new tools for the garden. Let us make a sign so everyone knows.

questions.rationale: 讨论后采纳花园种子包；A邻摊卖，B缺保温设施否定。

questions.stem: What should be clear on each pack?
options: The date of the next market.
questions.rationale: 盆栽或大花床空间要求写正面，购买前可知；B/C非标签信息。

questions.stem: What will the money be used for first?
questions.rationale: first偿还展板成本，余款再买工具；A颠倒先后，C未采用汤。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text:
Thank you for helping with the town sound map. We are collecting short recordings that show how familiar places sound at different times. A recording does not have to be loud or unusual. The quiet closing of a shop can be just as useful as a busy station.

Please make two recordings at your chosen place, one in the morning and one later in the day. Keep each one under a minute. Begin by saying the place and the time, but do not include names or private conversations. If somebody can be clearly heard speaking, choose another moment or ask the project leader whether the recording can be used.

Send your files by Sunday evening, together with one sentence explaining what changed between the two visits. We will not choose the loudest recordings as winners. There is no competition. The aim is to create a shared picture of the town through sound, and every usable contribution will help.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the project?
options: To create a sound portrait of the town.
To find the loudest public place.
questions.rationale: 末段shared picture through sound与开头目标一致；B/C不是竞赛标准。

questions.stem: How many recordings should each helper make?
questions.rationale: 同一地点早上和稍晚各一次，共二；A/C与明确数字冲突。
明确不含private conversations；A要求报时，B安静普通声可用。

questions.stem: What written information should accompany the files?
options: A sentence about the change between visits.
A review of the loudest station.
questions.rationale: 文件附一解释两次变化的句子；A无竞赛，C未要求评论最响车站。
